messages:
maya: Quick async standup: model onboarding / evals — ran Llama3-xxlq quantized onboarding_v2 promptset overnight. Summary: perf looks OK but I see an uptick in hallucination for the 'contact_info' category, especially when prefix length > 128. Blocker: can't reproduce locally yet, logs differ between hosted and my local run. Today: digging into KV-cache warmup and tokenizer diffs. Ping @alex for eval logs access.

alex: On it. Can you paste the eval batch id and example IDs? I'll pull logs from infra.

maya: Batch id: b-20240314-042. Example IDs: 41, 87, 119. Example 119 shows a truncated email being inserted where none should be. Short snippet: ```resp: 'Contact me at support@redwood.com

Regards'```

eval-bot: Auto-eval: b-20240314-042 | model: llama3-xxlq-q | metric: hallucination_rate +3.7% vs baseline, ROUGE stable, latency +12ms median. Failing prompt tags: contact_info, dates.

chris: :eyes: I can repro a small reg locally if I run with batching=8 and kv_cache disabled. Looks like a cache warmup mismatch between the serving runtime and local sim. I'll try with kv_cache enabled and compare.

sylvie: I reviewed the tokenizer PR that touched byte-pair mapping — PR #4821. Left a comment about '@' mapping. @maya can you try running the eval with tokenizer v2 shim? Quick command: ```python eval_runner.py --model llama3-xxlq-q --promptset onboarding_v2 --tokenizer v2 --batch 4```

maya: Thanks — running the above now against example 119 first. If that fixes it I will run the full batch. Also pinging SRE about canary routing; if we need to rollback we should freeze the rollout.

alex: Logs pulled. There is an indexing bug in the serving runtime that drops the first prefix token when requests come through the websocket proxy. Filing ticket INF-2173 and attaching stack traces.

chris: Great find. For mitigation: can we add a temporary routing rule to prefer direct gRPC nodes for this model until the runtime fix lands? @jen from eng-infra, can you toggle routing for the dedicated pool?

jen: I can flip routing to avoid the websocket proxy for the dedicated pool for the next hour. Doing that now :gear:.

maya: Ran tokenizer v2 locally — example 119 is fixed. Kicking off full batch run. If no other regressions I'll mark this as must-pass in the gating eval and proceed with onboard. Thanks team :heart:.

alex: :thumbsup: INF-2173 created and assigned to @chris for initial debug. I'll upload the traces to the ticket and follow up.

eval-bot: Update: full batch complete. hallucination_rate back to baseline after tokenizer v2. Closing temporary alert. Note: latency variance spike persists but SLOs still met. :white_check_mark:
